title: Unable to call the API locally
body: **Describe the bug** I can now use docker-compose to launch langflow locally. Currently, I can configure the following flow to do the build. Also, we were able to absorb conversations with AI. We are currently considering using this from an API rather than a GUI. Referring to the commands shown in [the documentation](https://docs.langflow.org/guidelines/api) and GUI, I executed the following command. ```bash curl -X POST \ http://localhost:3000/api/v1/process/32f1077c-70dc-49c0-8006-0c64ef8b02e6 \ -H 'Content-Type: application/json'\ -H 'x-api-key: sk-elo0IAfBfiMQkdpOZrw_6Hgxd1Pdo2zg22mD4BhCqIk'\ -d '{"inputs": {"input":""}, "tweaks": { "AmazonBedrock-1rYBo": {}, "ConversationChain-FFwTG": {} }}' ``` The response is as follows. ``` {"detail":"Error: One input key expected got ['repr', 'input']"} ``` **Browser and Version** - Browser chrome - Version v0.5.5 **To Reproduce** Steps to reproduce the behavior: 1. Build a flow 2. Generate an API key 3. Invoke curl command 4. See error

linked_prs.title: Ignore "repr" key in process_inputs
linked_prs.body:
The "repr" key was not being ignored when processing inputs. This PR updates the process_inputs function to ignore the "repr" key.

Fixes #1171
